howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 10:30 AM PDT 25 August 2026 Today Tonight and Wednesday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 15 to 25 knots diminishing to southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon then becoming light near midnight. Wind increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 near noon Wednesday. Showers tonight and Wednesday morning.
